name: NCOR Ontology 101 Working Group
summary: Learn applied ontology through practical modeling challenges, design patterns, discussion, and hands-on work with tools such as Protégé.
participation: An open forum for people new to applied ontology. Contact Bill Mandrick to arrange attendance in person or remotely.
cadence: Weekly, according to the public group page. Contact Bill for the current day, time, and joining details.
provenance: Purpose, open participation, weekly cadence, supported by NCOR. Confirm the current meeting details with the organizer.
